verdict.rationale: Community posts from the Gemini CLI launch thread confirm a Google 'Gemini CLI' exists. One user reports using it for about a month on very large codebases. Another reports it rejects Workspace accounts ('Ensure your Google account is not a Workspace account'), which limits who can use it. The first-party docs in the pack cover only the web, mobile and Mac apps and never mention a CLI. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the CLI, details of its agentic capabilities and commands, clear tie-in to the Gemini app subscription, and support for Workspace accounts.
